eyebrow: Five queries, scattered across this chapter

code:
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_HealthDashboard AS
SELECT 'Blocking' AS signal, ... FROM sys.dm_exec_requests
WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Slow Query', ... FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) st
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Fragmented Index', ... FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(...);
